channel.title: Termux-Diffusion: Production On-Device AI Image Generation Engine
channel.description: Official release updates, technical articles, and on-device tensor computing guides for Termux-Diffusion on Samsung Galaxy and Android Termux ARM64 hardware.

item.title: Termux-Diffusion v1.0.0 Initial Release: Native Bionic ARM64 Stable Diffusion Pipeline
item.description: Termux-Diffusion v1.0.0 delivers production-grade on-device AI image generation for Samsung Galaxy and Android Termux devices with dual Python and Node.js runtime engines, zero PRoot virtualization, and automated Samsung Gallery MediaStore indexing.
item.content:encoded:
Termux-Diffusion v1.0.0 introduces native Android Bionic libc execution for Stable Diffusion models with ARM64 NEON vectorization and GGML quantized weights.

Key features include 1-click bootstrap installation, 5 curated mobile presets, automatic CPU WakeLock management, and Samsung RAM Plus (zRAM) safety guards.

item.title: Benchmarking Stable Diffusion Quantization on Exynos 1380 & Snapdragon 8 Gen 3
item.description: In-depth analysis of Q4_K vs Q4_0 GGML tensor performance across mobile big.LITTLE core clusters, thermal throttling prevention, and memory utilization.
